title: He halted again and bought from the old applewoman two Banbury cakes for a penny and broke the brittle paste and threw its fragments down into the Liffey.
html_source:
There is always a payoff if you practice good deeds.

Ecclesiastes 11:1: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
